title: Darth Vader
description: DARTH VADER leads the Imperial forces that, through treachery and overwhelming fire power, have overthrown the Old Republic. Answerable only to the corrupt Emperor Palpatine, the Lord of the Sith was once a proud Jedi Knight who was seduced by the dark side of the Force. But he hasn't counted on the growing power of a new seeker of the Force, the young Luke Skywalker. As they battle, it becomes clear that there can be just one survivor.
